```yaml
name: AI Docs Review Command

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      pr_number:
        description: 'Pull Request Number'
        required: true
        type: number
      comment_id:
        description: 'Comment ID (optional, for reply context)'
        required: false
        type: string

permissions:
  pull-requests: write
  contents: read

jobs:
  ai-docs-review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Validate Inputs
        id: validate
        run: |
          if [ -z "${{ inputs.pr_number }}" ]; then
            echo "::error::PR number is required"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "pr_number=${{ inputs.pr_number }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Authenticate Octavia Bot
        id: auth
        uses: actions/create-github-app-token@v1
        with:
          app-id: ${{ secrets.OCTAVIA_BOT_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.OCTAVIA_BOT_PRIVATE_KEY }}

      - name: Fetch Changed Files
        id: fetch-files
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.auth.outputs.token }}
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ steps.validate.outputs.pr_number }}
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
        run: |
          # Get the PR details to determine base and head refs
          PR_DATA=$(gh api repos/$REPO/pulls/$PR_NUMBER)
          BASE_REF=$(echo "$PR_DATA" | jq -r '.base.ref')
          HEAD_REF=$(echo "$PR_DATA" | jq -r '.head.ref')
          
          # Fetch files changed in the PR
          # Using the compare endpoint works for both fork and non-fork PRs if we use the SHA
          HEAD_SHA=$(echo "$PR_DATA" | jq -r '.head.sha')
          BASE_SHA=$(echo "$PR_DATA" | jq -r '.base.sha')
          
          FILES=$(gh api repos/$REPO/compare/$BASE_SHA...$HEAD_SHA --jq '.files[].filename')
          
          # Check for connector changes
          # Pattern: airbyte-integrations/connectors/*/
          CONNECTOR_CHANGES=$(echo "$FILES" | grep -E '^airbyte-integrations/connectors/[^/]+/' || true)
          
          if [ -n "$CONNECTOR_CHANGES" ]; then
            echo "has_connector_changes=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "connector_files=$CONNECTOR_CHANGES" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "has_connector_changes=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Post Status Comment (Started)
        if: always()
        uses: thollander/actions-comment-pull-request@e4a76dd2b0a3c2027c3fd84147a67c22ee4c90fa
        with:
          pr-number: ${{ inputs.pr_number }}
          message: |
            🤖 **AI Docs Review Started**
            
            Analyzing connector changes for documentation recommendations...
          comment-tag: ai-docs-review-status
          mode: upsert

      - name: Post Status Comment (Skipped)
        if: steps.fetch-files.outputs.has_connector_changes == 'false'
        uses: thollander/actions-comment-pull-request@e4a76dd2b0a3c2027c3fd84147a67c22ee4c90fa
        with:
          pr-number: ${{ inputs.pr_number }}
          message: |
            ⏭️ **AI Docs Review Skipped**
            
            No connector changes detected in this PR. The `/ai-docs-review` command only applies to PRs modifying files under `airbyte-integrations/connectors/`.
          comment-tag: ai-docs-review-status
          mode: upsert

      - name: Trigger Devin AI Review
        if: steps.fetch-files.outputs.has_connector_changes == 'true'
        uses: aaronsteers/devin-action@main
        with:
          devin-token: ${{ secrets.DEVIN_TOKEN }}
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          org-id: ${{ secrets.DEVIN_ORG_ID }}
          issue-number: ${{ inputs.pr_number }}
          playbook-macro: '!connectordocs_pr_review'
          start-message: '🤖 **AI Docs Review in Progress**\n\nDevin is analyzing the connector changes and generating documentation recommendations. This may take a few minutes.'
          wait-for-stopped-status: true
          wait-minutes-max: 10

      - name: Post Status Comment (Error)
        if: failure() && steps.fetch-files.outputs.has_connector_changes == 'true'
        uses: thollander/actions-comment-pull-request@e4a76dd2b0a3c2027c3fd84147a67c22ee4c90fa
        with:
          pr-number: ${{ inputs.pr_number }}
          message: |
            ❌ **AI Docs Review Failed**
            
            An error occurred while processing the documentation review. Please check the workflow run logs for details.
          comment-tag: ai-docs-review-status
          mode: upsert
```
